title: Intake
description: The contract for the four Intake documents a school's data repository holds: the School day (intake/school-day.json), the Timetable (intake/timetable.json), Non-school days (intake/non-school-days.json) and the Term (intake/term.json). Each is validated against the matching definition under $defs. This one artifact is both what the validator uses and what the `prompt` command embeds, so the two cannot drift.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this contract the document was produced against. A document carrying any other version is rejected rather than misread.

provenance.description: Where this document came from, so an operator can tell whether it is stale when the school republishes its Source.

source.description: The name of the Source this document was parsed from, such as the artifact's filename.

sourceHash.description: A hash of the Source's bytes, so a republished Source is detectable.

agent.description: The agent that did the parsing, such as a model name.

timeOfDay.$comment: A scalar shape: its description is worded as a phrase because the validator quotes it back at the operator.
timeOfDay.description: a time of day as HH:MM, 24-hour

date.$comment: A scalar shape: its description is worded as a phrase because the validator quotes it back at the operator.

timestamp.$comment: A scalar shape: its description is worded as a phrase because the validator quotes it back at the operator.

weekday.description: A day of the week, in English and lower case, whatever language the school's own strings are in.

slot.description: A Slot: a time window during which a Lesson may be taught. It carries no number — a Slot is identified by its position among the School day's Slots.

break.description: A Break: a time window between two Slots during which no Lesson is taught. Its label is what the sheet renders; an unlabelled Break leaves no row.

schoolDayEntry.description: One entry in the School day's sequence: either a Slot or a Break, told apart by `kind`.

kind.$comment: Constrained further by the branches below.

lesson.description: A Lesson: one cell of the Timetable. A subject and nothing else — no teacher, no room, no group.

slot.description: The Slot's position among the School day's Slots, counting from 1 and ignoring Breaks.

subject.description: The subject exactly as the school names it; this is published verbatim.

nonSchoolDayRange.description: A labelled run of dates inside the Term on which no Lesson is taught. A single day is a range whose start and end are equal.

schoolDay.description: The School day: the ordered sequence of Slots and Breaks that every day of the week follows.

sequence.description: Slots and Breaks in the order they occur, from the first Slot of the day to the last.

timetable.description: The Timetable: the recurring weekly pattern of Lessons. Ragged days are normal — not every weekday and Slot pairing has a Lesson.

lessons.description: Every Lesson the week holds, in any order. A weekday and Slot identify at most one Lesson, so no two entries may name the same pair.

nonSchoolDays.description: The Non-school days: dates inside the Term on which no Lesson is taught, declared as labelled ranges rather than as individual dates.

term.description: The Term: the single date range over which the Timetable is in force. A school year with two terms is two runs against two Intakes.
